push.gatewayFooter: Pushes reach this app through the gateway in the orca-ios repository. Start the desktop with ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL set to it; without that, alerts and Live Activities update only while this app is open.
push.accepted: The desktop sent the test. Check for the notification.
push.notAccepted: The desktop didn’t send the test: {{reason}}
push.noDesktop: Connect a desktop and try again.

push.gatewayFooter: 推送经 orca-ios 仓库里的推送网关送到这个 App。启动桌面时把 ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL 设为网关地址；不设置的话，通知和实时活动只在 App 打开时更新。
push.accepted: 桌面已发出测试推送，请留意通知。
push.notAccepted: 桌面没有发出测试推送：{{reason}}
push.noDesktop: 请先连接一台桌面再试。

push.gatewayFooter: 推播經 orca-ios 儲存庫裡的推播閘道送到這個 App。啟動桌面時把 ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL 設為閘道位址；不設定的話，通知和即時動態只在 App 開啟時更新。
push.accepted: 桌面已送出測試推播，請留意通知。
push.notAccepted: 桌面沒有送出測試推播：{{reason}}
push.noDesktop: 請先連接一台桌面再試。
